newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Sidanko 96 oil output falls to 20.81 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Russia Sidanko 96 oil output falls to 20.81 mln T.

text.p: Russia's NK SIDANKO oil firm said on Thursday that it produced 20.81 million tonnes (equivalent to around 416,000 barrels per day) of crude oil and gas condensate in 1996, down from 22.87 million (some 457,000 bpd) in 1995.
The figures do not include production by joint ventures. The company forecast 1997 oil output steady at 20.36 million tonnes (407,000 bpd).

OAO Sibirsko-Dalnevostochnaya Neftyanaya Kompaniya said it refined 17.50 million tonnes of crude oil in 1996, down from 19.96 million tonnes in 1995. The firm plans to boost refinery output this year to 24.50 million tonnes.
SIDANKO exported 6.44 million tonnes in 1996, of which 4.73 million were delivered to countries outside the Commonwealth of Independent States.
Exports in 1995 totalled 6.46 million tonnes, including 5.52 million outside the CIS.
SIDANKO forecast total 1997 exports at 6.11 million tonnes, including 4.70 million tonnes outside the CIS.
The company is one of Russia's largest vertically-integrated oil groups.
Its main production units include Chernogorneft, Kondpetroleum and Varyoganneftegaz.
